title: A second registered launcher run on the same named root, after the root is re-named for a new claimed item, gets no registration or verification record (registrationBacked=false), while the first run worked
outcome: An agent that finishes one item and claims the next can re-name the same worktree as its source root and earn a registered committed-input verification for its next run. If registration is refused, the launcher and host state the exact reason at admission.
acceptance: A second registered launcher run on the same named root, after the root is re-named for a new claimed item, gets no registration or verification record (registrationBacked=false), while the first run worked is done
disposal_reason: Duplicate. Opus2 filed w-9200b26b7cb1 for the same defect (12329's second registered run test-dceeb957 got no record and no host reason) at the same time, with the fuller facts and the shared-root hypothesis. Kept that one, raised to P0.
